items.title: United States: 7 – 135 people are killed and dozens reported missing during a flood in Central Texas, United States.
Bangladesh reports a record 153 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the national death toll to 15,065.
Indonesia reports a record 555 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, 137 of them from Central Java, thereby bringing the national death toll to 60,582.
Flooding caused by torrential rain in China kills at least 180 people, mostly along the Yangtze river.
